hero.lead: AICTE receives complaints through the Regulation Bureau, the Public Grievance Redressal Cell and Regional Offices. This system brings them together, spots when bureaus are working on the same institution, and helps them coordinate.

about.title: About the Complaint Monitoring System
about.lead: AICTE regulates technical education in India. Complaints about institutions reach different bureaus, each with its own records. This system gives authorized officials one place to see every case, who is handling it, and where actions overlap.
about.visionText: Fair, timely and transparent redressal of grievances about technical institutions.
about.missionText: Give every bureau one shared, trusted view of each institution and its cases.
about.valuesText: Transparency, accountability, coordination and citizen-centric service.
about.rbText: Approvals, compliance and regulatory action on institutions.
about.pgrcText: Receives and resolves grievances from students, faculty and the public.
about.roText: Field-level verification and follow-up in each region.
about.otherText: Cells brought in when a case needs their expertise.
about.glanceNote: The system suggests links. Officials always decide the action.

fileComplaint.text: Complaints reach AICTE through the Public Grievance Redressal Cell, the Regulation Bureau or your Regional Office. Whichever office receives it, the case is registered here with a case ID so every bureau sees it.
details: Students, parents, faculty and the public can complain.
Name the institution as you know it. Short forms and spelling variations are matched to the right college.
Keep the case ID you receive. You need it to track the case.

about.text: Samanvay is AICTE's complaint monitoring system. It brings complaints from every bureau into one place, notices when two bureaus are working on the same institution, and helps them coordinate.

overlap.text: When a new complaint arrives, the system looks for open cases about the same institution in other bureaus. It compares what the complaints mean, their category and their dates. If they look related, officials see "Potential Overlapping Cases · Coordination Required".
details: "College is collecting extra donation" and "Students forced to pay beyond approved fees" are recognised as the same issue.
Officials can then link the cases, choose a lead bureau and share notes.
suggestions: Does the AI close cases on its own?

explainMatch.text: Every alert states why the cases were linked, so an official can verify it before acting. A typical explanation reads:
details: Same institution (AICTE Permanent ID)
Same category: Fees
78% similar complaint text
Raised 6 days apart
suggestions: Is SVIT the same as Swami Vivekanand Inst of Tech?

automation.text: The system only suggests links. An authorised official reviews every alert and decides what happens. Nothing is closed or merged automatically.

accuracy.text: Matching quality is measured on a labelled test set of case pairs, so the numbers can be checked.
details: Precision: {{precision}} of flagged pairs were real overlaps
Recall: {{recall}} of real overlaps were flagged
Every suggestion is still reviewed by an official.

privacy.text: Officials see only what their role allows: Regulation Bureau, PGRC, Regional Office or Senior Management. Every view and action is recorded in an audit trail.
details: On the public tracker you see the status, the bureau handling your case and the expected date.
Notes exchanged between bureaus are visible only to officials.

bureaus.text: Four groups work from the same records:
details: Regulation Bureau (RB): approvals, compliance and regulatory action
Public Grievance Redressal Cell (PGRC): grievances from students, faculty and the public
Regional Offices: field verification and follow-up
Senior Management: oversight across bureaus

timelines.text: Each case gets an expected disposal date when it is registered. Officers get reminders before the date, and cases that pass it are escalated to senior officials.
details: The tracker shows the expected disposal date for your case.

officerLogin.text: Authorised AICTE officials sign in to see cases, overlap alerts and reports for their bureau.

greeting.text: Namaste! I am the Samanvay assistant. I can check a complaint status, explain how bureaus coordinate, and tell you how your data is handled.

thanks.text: Happy to help. Ask me anything else about your complaint or how the system works.
